summary: The shared conversation contains brand exploration and project setup history. It does not contain customer, opportunity, commercial, product-performance, or outcome training.

records.statement: Use a friendly, optimistic seal mascot associated with the letter P as the primary character for P Decision Advisor.
records.notes: Visual preference only; it must not influence business recommendations.

records.statement: A luxury gold P monogram was explored as an alternative brand-mark direction.
records.notes: Reference concept, not a confirmed replacement for the seal mascot.

records.statement: The preferred homepage promise is: Think Wider. Decide Smarter. Go Further.
The AI advises and P makes the final decision.
records.notes: Consistent with the existing product reasoning contract.

records.statement: Present the advisor as a connected set of Product, Customer, Commercial, Relationship, Competition, Execution, Sustainability, Project, and Learning brains.
records.notes: A navigation and communication model; reasoning still follows the formal Decision Model.

records.statement: The project repository is PhucNgo71/phuc-decision-advisor and the current production site is hosted on Vercel.
